* **Location / Identity**: Lankou City · Senior Disciple of Zhenhai Martial Arts School.
* **Appearance**: Dark as raw iron, barrel-chested and thick-waisted; wears a sweat-stained white cloth headband year-round, flashing a mouthful of gleaming white teeth whenever he grins.
* **First Impression**: The sturdy pillar among the school's younger generation. He possesses Herculean strength and fights with straightforward honesty in the ring, yet off the platform, he often pays out of his own pocket to treat beaten opponents to bowls of hearty pork noodles.
* **Manner of Speech**: Passionate and simple-hearted. "Master always says getting beaten isn't shameful; failing to get back up is what's shameful. Come on, let's grab some noodles!"
* **Goals & Daily Life**: Aspires to open a Zhenhai Martial Arts branch at Caokou Market along the canal, shielding porters and manual laborers from the extortion of idle thugs.
* **Network**: Chief disciple to Guan Shanhai; childhood acquaintance of Lan Ali of Egret Fishing Village; never shows a pleasant face to the blade-wielding salt runners of Green Salt Beach.

lanchuan-p06.name: Lan Ali
lanchuan-p06.brief_description: The most skilled swimmer across the mudflats, capable of holding her breath beneath deep waters for half an hour without surfacing. Whenever someone's net snags on reef rocks, she readily dives into the sea to haul it free.
lanchuan-p06.content:
* **Location / Identity**: Egret Fishing Village · Fisherfolk Leader.
* **Appearance**: Skin tanned a healthy wheat shade, barefoot, wrists bound with red cotton cord to ward off evil, with a razor-sharp bone water-cleaving knife tucked at her waist.
* **First Impression**: The most skilled swimmer across the mudflats, capable of holding her breath beneath deep waters for half an hour without surfacing. Whenever someone's net snags on reef rocks, she readily dives into the sea to haul it free.
* **Manner of Speech**: Fiery and brisk, with a clear, ringing voice. "This sea is the rice bowl the heavens gave us all. Whoever dares toss sand into our bowl, I'll pin his instep to the ground with my fish gig!"
* **Goals & Daily Life**: Sworn to defend the ancestral mudflats and fishing waters of her village, refusing to yield a single inch to the salt gang.
* **Network**: Childhood friend of Zheng Tieniu; the old ferryman Song Laolu frequently buys her live catch; considers Gu Huaiyuan of Green Salt Beach a mortal enemy.

lanchuan-p07.name: Gu Huaiyuan
lanchuan-p07.brief_description: An iron-fisted leader ruling over dozens of hectares of salt pans at Green Salt Beach. His "Tide-Severing Saber" is ruthless and overbearing; both black and white paths along the sea take the long way around him.
lanchuan-p07.content:
* **Location / Identity**: Green Salt Beach · Illicit Salt Chieftain; Underworld Hegemon.
* **Appearance**: Long face with sunken cheeks, a deep, faded scar running straight from his left cheek to his jawline; wears a black iron thumb ring on his right index finger, his gaze cold and murky as still water.
* **First Impression**: An iron-fisted leader ruling over dozens of hectares of salt pans at Green Salt Beach. His "Tide-Severing Saber" is ruthless and overbearing; both black and white paths along the sea take the long way around him.
* **Manner of Speech**: Low, raspy, and bone-chilling, every word drawing blood. "Green Salt Beach feeds sixty orphans, widows, and elders. A single day without salt means an entire household starves. You preach heavenly justice to me, but who feeds their empty bellies?"
* **Goals & Daily Life**: Forcing Fan Shouzhuo of the Qingfu Association to publicly acknowledge the embezzled accounts from fifteen years ago, carving out a path of survival for his brothers.
* **Network**: Former life-and-death sworn brother to Guan Shanhai; views Lan Ali as an obstinate roadblock; fiercely protective of the salt laborers under his command.
* **[Author Reference]**: Formidable Foe B1. His self-created Tide-Severing Saber technique possesses three unique lethal arts, engineered specifically to sever wrists and slash back at the throat. If the player uncovers the missing original ledger pages through investigation, they can compel a peaceful reconciliation without drawing blades.

lanchuan-p08.name: Xu Zhu
lanchuan-p08.brief_description: The landlady of a cliffside inn who grills mouthwateringly aromatic spicy sea fish. Whenever someone probes for Jianghu secrets, she feigns deafness and plays dumb, claiming she is "old and forgetful."
lanchuan-p08.content:
* **Location / Identity**: Wangchao Cliff · Proprietress of Wangchao Inn; former senior intelligence broker of Rain Listening Pavilion.
* **Appearance**: Full head of silver hair held loosely by a green jade bamboo hairpin, eyes unruffled by any ripple, her right fingertips callused from decades of holding concealed darts.
* **First Impression**: The landlady of a cliffside inn who grills mouthwateringly aromatic spicy sea fish. Whenever someone probes for Jianghu secrets, she feigns deafness and plays dumb, claiming she is "old and forgetful."
* **Manner of Speech**: Detached, concealing sharp wit beneath an indifferent facade. "Are you here for a meal or a bed? For directions, head forward; for grudges, go down the mountain. This old woman only serves hot fish and warm wine."
* **Goals & Daily Life**: Living out her twilight years amidst the sea breeze of the sheer precipice, quietly filtering maritime rumors and secrets for Rain Listening Pavilion.
* **Network**: Sworn elder sister to Yan Shier of Qinghe City years ago; neighbor of Song Laolu for decades; even Mount Tai elders at Dongyue Terrace bow and cup their fists before her.
* **[Author Reference]**: Nineteen years ago, shortly before the Lanchuan Seven gathering at Mist Wave Manor caught fire, Rong Huaijin entrusted her with delivering an unsealed, handwritten secret letter to Rain Listening Pavilion. This letter remains stashed by Xu Zhu inside a stone crevice of the inn's rear pavilion to this day (triggers Core Pursuit P2 "Tale of the Seven Friends").

lanchuan-p09.name: Huo Qianli
lanchuan-p09.brief_description: The helmsman of the Wild Goose Escort Bureau, which spans land and water networks across the north and south. In twenty years of escorting shipments, he has never suffered a failure; he rarely smiles or jokes, earning the Jianghu epithet "Ten Thousand Li Without a Ripple."
lanchuan-p09.content:
* **Location / Identity**: Hedu Town · Chief Escort of the Wild Goose Escort Bureau; one of the "Lanchuan Seven".
* **Appearance**: Face dark red like a ripe date, lean and tall, clad in a dark gray cotton robe; eyes subdued and lusterless, steps as heavy and steady as cast iron.
* **First Impression**: The helmsman of the Wild Goose Escort Bureau, which spans land and water networks across the north and south. In twenty years of escorting shipments, he has never suffered a failure; he rarely smiles or jokes, earning the Jianghu epithet "Ten Thousand Li Without a Ripple."
* **Manner of Speech**: Placid as an ancient well. "The swifter the blade, the thinner one's life. An escort guards the two words 'safe passage,' not the vain glory of cutthroat brawls."
* **Goals & Daily Life**: Maintaining stability along north-south trade routes; safely delivering a grand escort of chipped imperial tribute porcelain; staring blankly at the salvage loss records of the old cargo ship in the dead of night.
* **Network**: Sworn brother to Liu Chenzhou, Yan Shier, and Li Changfeng among the "Lanchuan Seven" of old; mentoring elder to Yan Xiaowu; sworn elder brother to Chai Feng beyond the frontier.
* **[Author Reference]**: Nineteen years ago, when the "Changgeng" sank, incurring colossal indemnity, Huo Qianli liquidated his entire family estate and single-handedly bore half the reparations. Clenching his teeth, he built the Wild Goose Escort Bureau from nothing; for twenty years, every vessel, carriage, and horse in the bureau has strictly avoided the name "Changgeng" (Core Pursuit P2).

## Contacts and everyday life

He can discuss roads he travelled, accepted cargo and the old compensation he personally handled. Being one of the Seven Friends does not reveal everyone else’s secrets. Asked about the past, he first considers present escorts and clients; silence is not a confession.

He treats Yan Xiaowu as a junior but must also listen when experienced workers report exhausted teams. His next concern may be assigning northern work to someone familiar with the passes, repairing carts or resting a convoy. Life need not wait for an old case to be solved. A recovered account page can prompt questions; it cannot decide his reconciliation, retirement or ownership of the agency for him.

lanchuan-p10.name: Yan Xiaowu
lanchuan-p10.brief_description: The quickest-tongued, fastest-footed young scout in the bureau's rear yard. Gifted with superb lightness skill, not even the rustling of a leaf or blade of grass escapes his ears on the escort road.
lanchuan-p10.content:
* **Location / Identity**: Hedu Town · Scout of the Wild Goose Escort Bureau.
* **Appearance**: Lean build with a pointed chin, a roguish smirk hovering at the edge of his right eyebrow; wears light chamois boots, moving with the agile grace of an ape.
* **First Impression**: The quickest-tongued, fastest-footed young scout in the bureau's rear yard. Gifted with superb lightness skill, not even the rustling of a leaf or blade of grass escapes his ears on the escort road.
* **Manner of Speech**: Slick and honey-tongued, fiercely mindful of saving face. "With Yan Xiaowu scouting ahead, even the sparrows in the trees have to chirp their passcodes to us!"
* **Goals & Daily Life**: Longing to lead an escort convoy independently across the great deserts of Yanbei to meet the heroes beyond the northern passes.
* **Network**: Prize pupil of Huo Qianli; sworn brother through thick and thin with the player (if selecting the escort background); regularly runs errands and carries letters for Chai Feng at Broken Beacon Terrace beyond the frontier.

## Contacts and everyday life

Yan knows convoy chores, familiar stopping places and today’s assignments. He knows only what he has actually seen of the old loss records his elder studies at night. He can laugh about mistakes with horses, wheels and calls, while asking whether a visitor wants to learn or merely borrow the banner to intimidate someone.

Huo’s praise matters, but carrying his messages is not Yan’s whole life. He wants to handle a short escort reliably and knows danger can make him panic. He may ask for help checking cargo, practising or choosing a safer course. The player may travel with him or separately. Temporary help is not membership, and beating him in practice transfers neither his work nor his belongings.

lanchuan-p11.name: Ge Changgao
lanchuan-p11.brief_description: The veteran leader ruling over eight hundred li of waterways. Despite his limp, standing at the bow of a swaying wooden barge, he remains as steady and motionless as an iron anchor dropped into the deep.
lanchuan-p11.content:
* **Location / Identity**: Duckweed Dock · Grand Helm Master of the Surge Boat Gang.
* **Appearance**: Skin parched and wrinkled like an old walnut, slightly lame in his right leg; carries a tarnished antique bronze water-cleaving spike at his waist, his hands broad as cattail-leaf fans.
* **First Impression**: The veteran leader ruling over eight hundred li of waterways. Despite his limp, standing at the bow of a swaying wooden barge, he remains as steady and motionless as an iron anchor dropped into the deep.
* **Manner of Speech**: Raspy, overbearing, and laden with boatmen's proverbs. "If the rocks beneath the water won't budge, the sails at the bow can't be raised recklessly. Rules were bought with the lives of our ancestors; break the rules, and the whole lake capsizes!"
* **Goals & Daily Life**: Preserving the authority and seats of the veteran hall masters, suppressing his daughter's radical reforms, and ensuring a steady handover of leadership.
* **Network**: Father to Ge Qing; old sworn brother of Song Laolu; joined forces with the Wild Goose Escort Bureau to control land-and-water combined transit on Qingping Lake.

lanchuan-p12.name: Ge Qing
lanchuan-p12.brief_description: Only daughter of the old helm master, and leader of the younger boatmen on Qingping Lake. Her aquatic prowess surpasses her teacher's; she is dead set on distributing the profits of bulk water transport equally among scattered fishing households.
lanchuan-p12.content:
* **Location / Identity**: Duckweed Dock · Junior Helm Master of the Surge Boat Gang.
* **Appearance**: Ear-length short hair bound tightly with a red kerchief, tight-sleeved water suit, arms packed with lean muscle; holds an eight-foot wrought-iron punt pole, exuding a sharp and gallant air.
* **First Impression**: Only daughter of the old helm master, and leader of the younger boatmen on Qingping Lake. Her aquatic prowess surpasses her teacher's; she is dead set on distributing the profits of bulk water transport equally among scattered fishing households.
* **Manner of Speech**: Resonant, forceful, and never backing down. "Old rules preserve the riches of a few big shipyards, but new rules grant a livelihood to hundreds of little mud-skiff sampans. It's time these waters ran fresh!"
* **Goals & Daily Life**: Vigorously pushing forward the gang's new regulations to shatter the bulk freight monopoly held by the old boatmasters.
* **Network**: Daughter of Old Helm Master Ge Changgao; secretly trades waterway bank drafts with Su Xiaoman of the Qingfu Association; deeply respected by Xiang Danian of the Hengshan Sect's Liu branch.

lanchuan-p13.name: Auntie Zhong
lanchuan-p13.brief_description: Matriarch of Three Willows Inn, famed for her unparalleled wild duck porridge. In the rear courtyard of the inn, the premier guestroom remains bolted behind a massive iron padlock, unavailable for rent even if offered a hundred taels of gold.
lanchuan-p13.content:
* **Location / Identity**: Three Willows Inn · Proprietress; one of the "Lanchuan Seven".
* **Appearance**: Plump figure, wearing a blue-and-white checked apron around her waist with a heavy ring of brass keys; welcomes guests with a warm smile, yet a flicker of vigilance lingers deep in her eyes.
* **First Impression**: Matriarch of Three Willows Inn, famed for her unparalleled wild duck porridge. In the rear courtyard of the inn, the premier guestroom remains bolted behind a massive iron padlock, unavailable for rent even if offered a hundred taels of gold.
* **Manner of Speech**: Crisp, peppery, sharp of tongue yet soft at heart. "If you want hot porridge, sit down and wait; if you're in a hurry, scoop yourself cold water! Traveling the world, who doesn't carry a few pounds of karmic debt?"
* **Goals & Daily Life**: Watching over this ancient lakeside inn, wiping down and tidying that locked chamber day after day, waiting for an old friend who can never return.
* **Network**: Former head chef of Mist Wave Manor, the youngest of the Lanchuan Seven; once as close as kin to Liu Chenzhou and Rong Jiugao.
* **[Author Reference]**: That padlocked room is the old living quarter she has preserved for nineteen years for "Liu Chenzhou" (Mr. Liu of Snow Listening Cottage). She holds the *Red Pledge of the Seven Friends*, drawn up in blood wine during their Double Ninth sworn brotherhood (Core Pursuit P2).

lanchuan-p14.name: Rong Jiugao
lanchuan-p14.brief_description: The supreme legend of the martial world across Qingping Lake. His swordsmanship borders on the divine. For twenty years, he has secluded himself on an isolated island manor in the lake, carving a stone tablet that announces to the world: "The Master Receives No Guests."
lanchuan-p14.content:
* **Location / Identity**: Mist Wave Manor · Manor Lord; reclusive supreme sword master.
* **Appearance**: Hair and beard entirely snow-white, draped in a loose antique green satin robe, face withered and pale; wears the "Wave Listening Ancient Sword" at his waist, untouched in its scabbard for three years.
* **First Impression**: The supreme legend of the martial world across Qingping Lake. His swordsmanship borders on the divine. For twenty years, he has secluded himself on an isolated island manor in the lake, carving a stone tablet that announces to the world: "The Master Receives No Guests."
* **Manner of Speech**: Piercingly cold, parsimonious with words. "There are no guestrooms in this manor, and autumn winds stir the lake. Pray take your leave."
* **Goals & Daily Life**: Guarding the sealed two-story library pavilion on the island; every Double Ninth festival, he sits before the lonely pavilion, playing the zither and drinking alone in memory of his deceased son.
* **Network**: Father to the late Rong Huaijin; once sat and debated swordsmanship with Zhang Sanfeng of Wudang and Xuanci of Shaolin without yielding an inch; deeply revered and feared by Auntie Zhong.
* **[Author Reference]**: Formidable Foe B6. One of the world's peerless swordsmen. When his only son Rong Huaijin perished in the inferno years ago, he harbored bitter hatred toward the Seven Friends for "standing by and doing nothing," unaware that his son was crushed by a falling crossbeam precisely because he shoved Li Changfeng out of the window. Possesses the *Fragmented Manual of the Mist Wave Sword* (Core Pursuit P2, Formidable Foe B6).

lanchuan-p15.name: Auntie Lian
lanchuan-p15.brief_description: A water-chestnut gathering woman of the village, exceptionally adept in water lore and capable of identifying a hundred varieties of rare aquatic medicinal herbs across Qingping Lake. The waterside tunes she hums are sorrowful yet gentle, deeply moving to the soul.
lanchuan-p15.content:
* **Location / Identity**: Water-Chestnut Song Village · Water-chestnut harvester; folk herbalist.
* **Appearance**: Wears a wide-brimmed bamboo conical hat, her coarse blue cloth blouse washed pale; voice sweet and melodious as a mountain spring, her slender hands peeling water chestnuts with lightning speed.
* **First Impression**: A water-chestnut gathering woman of the village, exceptionally adept in water lore and capable of identifying a hundred varieties of rare aquatic medicinal herbs across Qingping Lake. The waterside tunes she hums are sorrowful yet gentle, deeply moving to the soul.
* **Manner of Speech**: Soft and measured, tinged with the moist breath of the water country. "Water plants have spirits too. If you gouge them brutally with an iron spade, they wither away right before your eyes; if you nourish them with clear water, they reward you with life-saving medicine."
* **Goals & Daily Life**: Foraging rare aquatic herbs along the water's edge and safeguarding the aquatic veins of Water-Chestnut Song Village from destruction by outside herb peddlers.
* **Network**: Frequently supplies precious aquatic herbs to Du Ruo of Huichun Hall on Cangwu Ridge; the tunes she constantly hums are melodies composed by Rong Huaijin in his youth.

lanchuan-p16.name: Xiang Danian
lanchuan-p16.brief_description: The most valued senior disciple of Liu Zhengfeng, the second-in-command of the Southern Peak's Mount Heng Sect. Recently, he has been shuttling between Qingping Lake and Returning Wild Goose Peak, helping his master organize the realm-shaking Golden Basin Hand-Washing Ceremony.
lanchuan-p16.content:
* **Location / Identity**: Mount Heng Sect; eldest disciple under Liu Zhengfeng.
* **Appearance**: Thick eyebrows and large eyes with a resolute expression. Wears a brand-new azure Mount Heng robe and carries a pine-patterned longsword on his back, strictly adhering to rules and etiquette in all conduct.
* **First Impression**: The most valued senior disciple of Liu Zhengfeng, the second-in-command of the Southern Peak's Mount Heng Sect. Recently, he has been shuttling between Qingping Lake and Returning Wild Goose Peak, helping his master organize the realm-shaking Golden Basin Hand-Washing Ceremony.
* **Voice & Demeanor**: Dignified, polite, and poised. "My master has cherished musical theory all his life and is weary of conflict. After the Double Ninth Festival, he will retire to the mountain forests. We hope heroes across the realm will come to bear witness."
* **Goals & Daily Routine**: Thoroughly receive guests from all quarters of the martial forest, and stay vigilant against the Songshan Sect stirring up trouble at the Hand-Washing Ceremony.
* **Relationship Network**: Master Liu Zhengfeng; nephew-disciple of Sect Leader Master Mo Da; on good terms with Ge Qing of the Canglang Boat Gang.
* **[Author's Reference]**: Xiang Danian has deeply inherited Liu Zhengfeng's Whirling Wind Falling Wild Goose Swordplay and is full of loyalty and valor. Aware of recent abnormal movements of the Songshan Sect's command flags around Lake Dongting, he is secretly mobilizing Mount Heng experts to guard against unforeseen crises.

lanchuan-p17.name: Lu Youjiao
lanchuan-p17.brief_description: The current Chief of the Beggar Gang, the greatest sect in the world. Despite standing atop countless gangs, he sits year-round by the massive iron cauldron at Old Locust Dock, sharing bowls of mixed-grain porridge with common brothers at the grassroots.
lanchuan-p17.content:
* **Location / Identity**: Old Locust Dock; Chief of the Beggar Gang; leader of the Dirty Clothes Faction.
* **Appearance**: Graying temples, dressed in a tattered robe covered with dense, coarse cloth patches. Weather-beaten face, holding an emerald-translucent bamboo Dog Beating Staff in his hand.
* **First Impression**: The current Chief of the Beggar Gang, the greatest sect in the world. Despite standing atop countless gangs, he sits year-round by the massive iron cauldron at Old Locust Dock, sharing bowls of mixed-grain porridge with common brothers at the grassroots.
* **Voice & Demeanor**: Rustic, upright, and gruff. "A beggar's foundation is begging for food on the streets, not acting like high officials. Clean hands and an open heart are what make a man worthy of wearing these patches!"
* **Goals & Daily Routine**: Relieve poor brothers across the land, uphold the gang's reputation of loyalty and righteousness, and strictly prevent the Clean Clothes Faction from turning into a corrupt elite clan.
* **Relationship Network**: Direct descendant successor of the Divine Beggar Hong Qigong; secretly marginalized by Elder Chen Youliang; very supportive of the clever and capable Three-Bag Disciple Pu Xiaoqi.
* **[Author's Reference]**: Though Lu Youjiao inherited the Dog Beating Staff Technique, he can barely unleash the first twelve stances of the Eighteen Dragon Subduing Palms, and his palm strikes are sluggish and difficult to deliver. Day and night, he worries over the severance of the final six stances and has secretly sent men to seek the whereabouts of the missing former Chief Qi Wujiu (Core Quest P1: "Broken Palm").

lanchuan-p18.name: Chen Youliang
lanchuan-p18.brief_description: The most politically astute and influential elder among the Beggar Gang's younger generation. He controls docks, taxation profits, and canal laborer authority throughout the Lianghuai region, with disciples spread across major sects.
lanchuan-p18.content:
* **Location / Identity**: Old Locust Dock; Beggar Gang Eight-Bag Executive Elder; leader of the Clean Clothes Faction.
* **Appearance**: Jade-smooth face and an impeccably trimmed long beard. Though patched on the surface, his inner lining is made of prized Shu brocade. His eyes glance around with spirited, veiled brilliance.
* **First Impression**: The most politically astute and influential elder among the Beggar Gang's younger generation. He controls docks, taxation profits, and canal laborer authority throughout the Lianghuai region, with disciples spread across major sects.
* **Voice & Demeanor**: Ornate, airtight rhetoric. "Chief Lu's righteousness is admirable, but hundreds of thousands of brothers cannot fill their bellies on backbone alone. Only with flowing silver and coin can our gang secure a foothold between court and commons."
* **Goals & Daily Routine**: Befriend gentry, wealthy merchants, and martial overlords, plotting to usurp the Dog Beating Staff and take total control of the Beggar Gang as a piece in his grand bid for worldly supremacy.
* **Relationship Network**: Secret disciple of Shaolin's Primordial Chaos Thunderbolt Hand Cheng Kun; vigorously sidelines conservative Elder Niu Bushi; attempts to court Tingyu Tower of Lianghuai.

lanchuan-p19.name: Niu Bushi
lanchuan-p19.brief_description: The gang's oldest and most stubborn veteran. Boasts that he hasn't done an honest day of work in his life and built his name purely on begging; detests disciples of the Clean Clothes Faction wearing silks and colors.
lanchuan-p19.content:
* **Location / Identity**: Old Locust Dock; Beggar Gang Martial Arts Transmission Conservative Elder.
* **Appearance**: Disheveled, tangled gray hair, slightly lame in the left leg, leaning on a heavy old jujube-wood crutch. Possesses a thunderous, explosive temper, prone to loud swearing.
* **First Impression**: The gang's oldest and most stubborn veteran. Boasts that he hasn't done an honest day of work in his life and built his name purely on begging; detests disciples of the Clean Clothes Faction wearing silks and colors.
* **Voice & Demeanor**: Furious and thunderous. "Bullshit! Beggars wearing silk—the founding masters won't be able to stay in their coffins! I'm illiterate, but I know the gang's rules!"
* **Goals & Daily Routine**: Guard the spirit wall before the Old Locust Dock headquarters without taking a step away, determined to prevent Chen Youliang from tampering with ancestral tenets.
* **Relationship Network**: Former Chief Qi Wujiu's personal staff-bearing disciple in earlier years; childhood acquaintance of Monk Dingyan from the Shaolin Pagoda Forest; despises Chen Youliang.
* **[Author's Reference]**: Besides the person in question, Niu Bushi is the only person in the world who knows why Qi Wujiu "crippled his own final six palm stances" and fled into hiding under an alias. He hides a secret sheet of the palm technique's mental mnemonics, torn by Qi Wujiu's own hand (Core Quest P1).

lanchuan-p20.name: Pu Xiaoqi
lanchuan-p20.brief_description: The most popular young beggar on the Lianghuai grand docks. Whenever a merchant stall is shorthanded or a poor family cannot put food on the table, he hoists his carrying pole and rushes to help.
lanchuan-p20.content:
* **Location / Identity**: Caokou Market; Beggar Gang Three-Bag Disciple; porter leader.
* **Appearance**: Lean and wiry build with calluses as thick as oxhide worn into his shoulders. Tucked at his waist is a glossy, oiled hard-jujube carrying pole.
* **First Impression**: The most popular young beggar on the Lianghuai grand docks. Whenever a merchant stall is shorthanded or a poor family cannot put food on the table, he hoists his carrying pole and rushes to help.
* **Voice & Demeanor**: Quick-witted, nimble, and peppered with underworld slang. "Pardon, Boss! Wind under my feet, gold on my shoulders! Clear three feet of the highway for your brother, and may your business thrive with rolling fortune!"
* **Goals & Daily Routine**: Lead dozens of young dock laborers to earn extra measures of unpolished rice, shielding them from foreman exploitation and wage gouging.
* **Relationship Network**: A Dirty Clothes Faction prospect favored by Lu Youjiao; shares a bond with the "Ferry Visitor" player regarding back pay owed by an old boat master.

lanchuan-p21.name: Yan Shier
lanchuan-p21.brief_description: A renowned spymaster and news broker of the realm. Tingyu Tower handles thousands of secret dispatches daily, yet Tower Master Yan Shier enforces an iron rule: Tingyu Tower never tells lies, but it never tells the whole truth either.
lanchuan-p21.content:
* **Location / Identity**: Qinghe City; Master of Tingyu Tower; one of the "Seven Friends of Lanchuan".
* **Appearance**: Exceptionally lean, wearing a plain gray loose robe with hair half-tied. Half of her right ring finger is missing. Her tea-holding hand is rock-steady, her brow and eyes calm as a chill pond in late autumn.
* **First Impression**: A renowned spymaster and news broker of the realm. Tingyu Tower handles thousands of secret dispatches daily, yet Tower Master Yan Shier enforces an iron rule: Tingyu Tower never tells lies, but it never tells the whole truth either.
* **Voice & Demeanor**: Refined, tranquil, with every word carrying immense weight. "Truth is the most expensive commodity in the martial world, and falsehoods the cheapest. A guest may afford the truth, but may not survive the price of knowing it."
* **Goals & Daily Routine**: Command an intelligence network spanning the world while secretly suppressing the earth-shattering secret of who sank the *Changgeng* nineteen years ago.
* **Relationship Network**: Brains of the former Seven Friends of Lanchuan; Xu Zhu's former superior; neither Shaolin nor Wudang trades intelligence with her, yet both treat her with wary deference.
* **[Author's Reference]**: She jealously guards the scorched corner of the original *Changgeng* cargo ledger (I53) and severed mooring cables. She knows full well the disaster nineteen years ago was no natural calamity, but a money-laundering trap jointly orchestrated by the imperial navy and merchant magnates (Core Quest P2).

lanchuan-p22.name: Qiao Buduan
lanchuan-p22.brief_description: A famed master storyteller throughout the Lianghuai region. His signature trick is striking the gavel at the most critical life-or-death juncture—announcing, "To know what happens next, listen to the next installment," driving a hall full of tea guests to thump their chests in frustration.
lanchuan-p22.content:
* **Location / Identity**: Qinghe City; head storyteller on the ground floor teahouse of Tingyu Tower.
* **Appearance**: Slightly portly, pale and beardless, with a goatee. Waves a Xiangfei bamboo folding fan with exquisite timing and measure.
* **First Impression**: A famed master storyteller throughout the Lianghuai region. His signature trick is striking the gavel at the most critical life-or-death juncture—announcing, "To know what happens next, listen to the next installment," driving a hall full of tea guests to thump their chests in frustration.
* **Voice & Demeanor**: Rhythmic, cadenced, and full of streetwise wit. "No rush, honored guests! When heroes suffer, Heaven intervenes; when petty men triumph, it never lasts. First allow Qiao to wet his throat!"
* **Goals & Daily Routine**: Gather bizarre cases and rumors across the land, arrange new stories, and help Yan Shier test waters and probe opinions among tea patrons.
* **Relationship Network**: Public-facing rumor scout for Yan Shier; inadvertently became one of the sources spreading the rumors about Shaolin's Yijin Jing (Task A09).

lanchuan-p23.name: Bai Henian
lanchuan-p23.brief_description: Leader of the Lichun Troupe, who has spent a lifetime singing the saga of the Yang Clan Generals. Onstage, his desolately righteous high pitch moves listeners to tears; offstage, dozens of his acrobats and martial performers possess solid, formidable hand-to-hand combat skills.
lanchuan-p23.content:
* **Location / Identity**: Sangma Town; troupe master of the Lichun Troupe; renowned *laosheng* (elder male role) master.
* **Appearance**: Spine straight as a spear, a handsome three-strand beard groomed without a single stray hair, bright energetic eyes, and a gait naturally carrying theatrical stage rhythm.
* **First Impression**: Leader of the Lichun Troupe, who has spent a lifetime singing the saga of the Yang Clan Generals. Onstage, his desolately righteous high pitch moves listeners to tears; offstage, dozens of his acrobats and martial performers possess solid, formidable hand-to-hand combat skills.
* **Voice & Demeanor**: Righteous, resonant, with crisp, standard enunciation. "Though small, the stage portrays loyalty, filial piety, and integrity; broad as the martial world is, it leaves no room for villainy."
* **Goals & Daily Routine**: Repair the termite-eaten roof pillars of the stage, secure the livelihood of dozens of troupe members, and pass down his *laosheng* master art.
* **Relationship Network**: Strict master and adoptive father to the martial maiden Hongxiao; honored guest of Jiang Qinghe at Qinghe Pharmacy; secretly well-versed in the musical repertoire of Mount Heng's Liu faction.

lanchuan-p24.name: Jiang Qinghe
lanchuan-p24.brief_description: A praised living Bodhisattva throughout the Lianghuai area. She flattened the threshold of the pharmacy specifically to let pushcarts carry the wounded through; she charges nothing to the poor and often covers the cost of herbal decoctions herself.
lanchuan-p24.content:
* **Location / Identity**: Sangma Town; resident physician at Qinghe Pharmacy; former head disciple of Huichun Hall.
* **Appearance**: Tall and slender, in plain robes with a thorn hairpin. Her fingers are long and spotless, always carrying a faint fragrance of angelica and licorice. Her expression is focused and serene.
* **First Impression**: A praised living Bodhisattva throughout the Lianghuai area. She flattened the threshold of the pharmacy specifically to let pushcarts carry the wounded through; she charges nothing to the poor and often covers the cost of herbal decoctions herself.
* **Voice & Demeanor**: Serene as water, brook-no-argument. "Extend your hand. Floating pulse, excessive liver fire. Stop bickering with strangers, drink three extra bowls of plain water, and fetch your medicine from the back."
* **Goals & Daily Routine**: Practice medicine to relieve suffering in this key canal town, and secretly concoct a cooling detox powder capable of countering strange Guanzhong poisons.
* **Relationship Network**: Former favored female disciple of Hall Master Du Ruo of Huichun Hall; revered like a deity by the Lichun Troupe's martial performers; knows the background of Herb Merchant Guild Master Luo Banxia.

lanchuan-p25.name: Xuan Ci
lanchuan-p25.brief_description: Grand master and leader of a generation at Shaolin Monastery. Boundless in Buddhist doctrine, his Great Weituo Pestle and Great Vajra Palm shake the martial forest, earning him the title "Tiger-Taming Arhat."
lanchuan-p25.content:
* **Location / Identity**: Shaolin Monastery; Abbot; supreme leader of the Buddhist realm.
* **Appearance**: Clad in a woven brocade golden-bat kasaya, with white brows drooping past his cheeks. A face at once benevolent and solemn, yet with deep, unreadable eyes. Carries a nine-ringed monk's staff.
* **First Impression**: Grand master and leader of a generation at Shaolin Monastery. Boundless in Buddhist doctrine, his Great Weituo Pestle and Great Vajra Palm shake the martial forest, earning him the title "Tiger-Taming Arhat."
* **Voice & Demeanor**: Magnanimous, tolerant, and compassionate. "Amitabha. Sectarian barriers are easily breached, but the demonic hindrances in one's heart are hard to purge. Benefactor has traveled far; drink a cup of spring water first."
* **Goals & Daily Routine**: Preserve Shaolin's thousand-year foundation and righteous reputation, harbor great compassion, and resist the Songshan Sect's annexation ambitions.
* **Relationship Network**: Senior brother to Xuan Ji of the Discipline Yard and Xuan Nan of the Bodhidharma Yard; guiding elder to guest-receiving monk Xuzhu; long-time spiritual correspondent with Zhang Sanfeng of Wudang.
* **[Author's Reference]**: Deep within his heart lies the grave error of the ambush against Khitan warriors at Yanmen Pass thirty years ago. This lifelong torment is the underlying reason for his extreme forbearance toward worldly conflicts (covertly linked to the Shaolin main storyline).

lanchuan-p26.name: Xuan Ji
lanchuan-p26.brief_description: Master of the Discipline Yard whose name strikes dread into the monastery's warrior monks. Strictly upright, unforgiving, and unable to tolerate a single speck of dust; handles punishment for monks and lay disciples who break monastic precepts.
lanchuan-p26.content:
* **Location / Identity**: Shaolin Monastery; Head of the Discipline Yard.
* **Appearance**: Bronze-skinned, horizontal eyebrows over glaring eyes, corners of the mouth pulled down hard. Massive, iron-tower frame, wielding a disciplinary iron staff.
* **First Impression**: Master of the Discipline Yard whose name strikes dread into the monastery's warrior monks. Strictly upright, unforgiving, and unable to tolerate a single speck of dust; handles punishment for monks and lay disciples who break monastic precepts.
* **Voice & Demeanor**: Swift, resolute, and iron-faced. "Monastic rules must be enforced upon violators! Even were it the Head of Bodhidharma Yard, breaking the precepts means thirty blows with the iron staff!"
* **Goals & Daily Routine**: Rigorously investigate the Sutra Pavilion scripture leak, defend the gate curfews of Mount Shaoshi, and eradicate infiltrations by Songshan Sect scouts.
* **Relationship Network**: Junior brother to Xuan Ci; disciplines Xuzhu severely; once had fierce disputes with the old village elder of Maihuang Village over tenancy land rent accounts.

lanchuan-p27.name: Xuzhu
lanchuan-p27.brief_description: The lowliest, most timid novice at Shaolin's mountain gates. Bows with palms clasped to anyone he meets, speaks hesitantly, and his greatest daily wish is not misreading scriptures during morning and evening chants, and not spilling vegetarian noodle soup on pilgrims.
lanchuan-p27.content:
* **Location / Identity**: Shaolin Monastery; young monk of the Guest Reception Quarters.
* **Appearance**: Thick eyebrows, large eyes, slightly upturned nostrils, and a round head. Tense and timid demeanor, washed-out kasaya, and a small wooden fish at his waist that he never parts with.
* **First Impression**: The lowliest, most timid novice at Shaolin's mountain gates. Bows with palms clasped to anyone he meets, speaks hesitantly, and his greatest daily wish is not misreading scriptures during morning and evening chants, and not spilling vegetarian noodle soup on pilgrims.
* **Voice & Demeanor**: Clumsy, stuttering, and apologetic. "T-this humble monk, Xuzhu, greets the benefactors... The broth is h-hot, please, please eat carefully..."
* **Goals & Daily Routine**: Fetch water, sweep floors, serve noodles in the Guest Reception Quarters, recite the *Lotus Sutra*, and long to one day enter the Arhat Yard to formally study a solid set of Arhat Fist.
* **Relationship Network**: Quietly watched over by Xuan Ci; frequently penalized by Xuan Ji; regular customer of the old noodle stall keeper on Temple Front Street.

lanchuan-p28.name: Dingyan
lanchuan-p28.brief_description: A mysterious old monk who has swept fallen leaves in the silent Pagoda Forest behind Shaolin for forty years. Daily, he holds only a broom, circling the most ancient desolate pagoda.
lanchuan-p28.content:
* **Location / Identity**: Shaolin Monastery; elder guardian monk of the Pagoda Forest.
* **Appearance**: Gaunt as an aged pine, clad in a patchwork hemp monk's robe. Fingers thick as withered roots, eyes half-open and half-closed, his inner brilliance thoroughly concealed.
* **First Impression**: A mysterious old monk who has swept fallen leaves in the silent Pagoda Forest behind Shaolin for forty years. Daily, he holds only a broom, circling the most ancient desolate pagoda.
* **Voice & Demeanor**: Terse, indifferent, trailing off like a fading breeze. "The characters on the stele have worn away, but the characters in the heart remain. Young man, turn back; there are only dead men here."
* **Goals & Daily Routine**: Watch over the Wordless Stele, obey his late master's instructions, and await a destined individual to uncover the ancient alliance between Shaolin and the Beggar Gang.
* **Relationship Network**: High monk of Xuan Ci's uncle-master generation; exchanged fist manuals in youth with Qi Wujiu, who now hides in Mount Taihe.
* **[Author's Reference]**: Formidable Foe B5. Possesses supreme Weituo Pestle skill; if someone forcibly trespasses deep into the Pagoda Forest, his iron broom can sweep aside ten-thousand-pound flying stones. The *Pagoda Forest Rubbing* (I58) he holds is a crucial clue to reconstructing the final six stances of the Dragon Subduing Palms.

lanchuan-p29.name: Fei Bin
lanchuan-p29.brief_description: The most powerful enforcer in the Songshan Sect second only to Zuo Lengchan. His "Great Songyang Divine Palm" possesses mountain-moving force; under the Five Sacred Mountains Command Flag, he oversees inspections at the foot of the mountain.
lanchuan-p29.content:
* **Location / Identity**: Songshan Sect; Second Taibao, known as "Great Songyang Hand".
* **Appearance**: Sallow skin, a predatory gaze, dressed in black brocade archer sleeves. His hands are unusually large and faintly tinged with crimson.
* **First Impression**: The most powerful enforcer in the Songshan Sect second only to Zuo Lengchan. His "Great Songyang Divine Palm" possesses mountain-moving force; under the Five Sacred Mountains Command Flag, he oversees inspections at the foot of the mountain.
* **Voice & Demeanor**: Condescending, with veiled murderous intent. "The Command Flag of the Five Sacred Mountains Alliance Leader is here! Leader Zuo decrees: anyone who hinders the great cause of merging the sects is colluding with the Demonic Cult and shall be slain without mercy!"
* **Goals & Daily Routine**: Set up checkpoints to cut off roads beneath Mount Shaoshi, secretly monitor Shaolin movements, and coerce or bribe Central Plains heroes into submitting to Songshan.
* **Relationship Network**: Junior brother and primary hound of Zuo Lengchan; maintains secret communication channels with Lao Denuo of Mount Hua; utterly despises Liu Zhengfeng's Hand-Washing ceremony.

lanchuan-p30.name: Ji Wenmo
lanchuan-p30.brief_description: Proprietress of the copying workshop situated below the Shaolin gate for years. Beyond transcribing scriptures for customers, she pens dozens of anonymous damaged sutra fragments daily, labeled "Free Karmic Gift" for impoverished travelers.
lanchuan-p30.content:
* **Location / Identity**: Temple Front Street; female proprietress of the Scripture Copying Workshop.
* **Appearance**: Elegant and dignified face, fingertips slightly stained with ink, plainly and cleanly dressed, carrying the gentle air unique to scholars.
* **First Impression**: Proprietress of the copying workshop situated below the Shaolin gate for years. Beyond transcribing scriptures for customers, she pens dozens of anonymous damaged sutra fragments daily, labeled "Free Karmic Gift" for impoverished travelers.
* **Voice & Demeanor**: Soft, gentle, with precise pronunciation. "Buddhism does not reside in deep mountain pavilions, but within a single thought of ordinary people. Though my calligraphy is crude, understanding it can reduce a moment of wrath."
* **Goals & Daily Routine**: Collate scattered Buddhist ancient volumes from across the land and secretly search for a Sanskrit manuscript lost for decades.
* **Relationship Network**: Permitted by Abbot Xuan Ci to borrow texts from the Outer Pavilion; close personal friend of Chang Xiaoqiu from Maihuang Village; Xuzhu often visits to borrow brushes and ink.

lanchuan-p31.name: Chang Shoutian
lanchuan-p31.brief_description: The leading farmer of Maihuang Village, who has tended Shaolin's monastery fields for fifty years. Both respectful and resentful toward the monks above, his greatest dread is the monastery's new accounting monks jacking up the land rent.
lanchuan-p31.content:
* **Location / Identity**: Maihuang Village; Village Head and Shaolin tenant farmer.
* **Appearance**: Dark, wrinkled face like tree bark, slightly hunched back, muddy feet, holding a pinch of tobacco leaves in coarse hands, wearing a face of perpetual worry.
* **First Impression**: The leading farmer of Maihuang Village, who has tended Shaolin's monastery fields for fifty years. Both respectful and resentful toward the monks above, his greatest dread is the monastery's new accounting monks jacking up the land rent.
* **Voice & Demeanor**: Sighing, full of grievance. "Bodhisattvas need food, but we farmers must survive too. This year was clearly a rocky sandbank, yet they recorded it as premium paddy field. How can we ever pay this rent...?"
* **Goals & Daily Routine**: Plead for an audience with Abbot Xuan Ci to present a grievance petition and have the miscalculated wasteland rents refunded to the villagers.
* **Relationship Network**: Father of Chang Xiaoqiu; reprimanded multiple times by Xuan Ji of the Discipline Yard; received charitable aid from Ji Wenmo.

lanchuan-p32.name: Chang Xiaoqiu
lanchuan-p32.brief_description: The only literate girl in the village. Households ask her to calculate grain-borrowing deeds and field yield distributions. Fierce and unyielding, she dares to argue fiercely with Shaolin warrior monks over half a sack of wheat.
lanchuan-p32.content:
* **Location / Identity**: Maihuang Village; young female bookkeeper.
* **Appearance**: Wears a thick, dark braid and a floral-patterned home-spun cotton jacket washed pale blue. Determined, bright eyes, with a small cloth bag holding a slate and slate pencil at her waist.
* **First Impression**: The only literate girl in the village. Households ask her to calculate grain-borrowing deeds and field yield distributions. Fierce and unyielding, she dares to argue fiercely with Shaolin warrior monks over half a sack of wheat.
* **Voice & Demeanor**: Crisp, brisk, and uncompromising. "Dharma is Dharma, and the abacus is the abacus! The boundary stone clearly reads 'Chang Family Private Property'—by what right do you log it into the monastery's merit fields?!"
* **Goals & Daily Routine**: Audit all temple field deeds across the village and demand that the Shaolin Discipline Yard correct their books.
* **Relationship Network**: Daughter of Old Village Head Chang Shoutian; close friend to Ji Wenmo and Shaolin's Xuzhu.

lanchuan-p33.name: Song Yuanqiao
lanchuan-p33.brief_description: Eldest disciple of Grandmaster Zhang Sanfeng, managing all Wudang affairs on his master's behalf. His internal Pure Yang Boundless Skill is peerless. Broad-minded, humble, and gentle, he enjoys deep respect from both the righteous and underworld factions across the land.
lanchuan-p33.content:
* **Location / Identity**: Mount Taihe; Head Administrator of Zixiao Temple; leader of the Seven Heroes of Wudang.
* **Appearance**: Face like jade, long beard brushing his chest, clad in a dark-teal silk Daoist robe. Displays an immortal demeanor and gentle, elegant refinement, carrying the true aura of a premier sect leader.
* **First Impression**: Eldest disciple of Grandmaster Zhang Sanfeng, managing all Wudang affairs on his master's behalf. His internal Pure Yang Boundless Skill is peerless. Broad-minded, humble, and gentle, he enjoys deep respect from both the righteous and underworld factions across the land.
* **Voice & Demeanor**: Dignified, scholarly, and unhurried. "The gates of Mount Taihe stand wide to welcome virtuous guests from all directions. Victory and defeat are passing clouds; only the Dao follows nature, endlessly cycling."
* **Goals & Daily Routine**: Oversee Wudang's rules, guard Grandmaster Zhang Sanfeng's secluded cultivation, and defuse the hostility surrounding Shen Guhe's return to challenge the mountain before the Double Ninth Festival.
* **Relationship Network**: Leader of the Seven Heroes of Wudang; biological father of Song Qingshu; pillars of the righteous path alongside Shaolin's Xuan Ci.

lanchuan-p34.name: Yu Lianzhou
lanchuan-p34.brief_description: The most skilled in martial arts and deepest in temperament among the Seven Heroes of Wudang. Creator of lethal techniques like the "Tiger Claw Extinction Hand." Though icy on the surface, he is fiercely protective of his sect and fellows.
lanchuan-p34.content:
* **Location / Identity**: Mount Taihe; Executive Deacon of Zixiao Temple; Second Hero of Wudang.
* **Appearance**: Cold and severe as iron, eyes flashing like lightning. Tall, upright posture, wearing a tight-sleeved gray cloth Daoist robe with a sword at his waist, radiating an intimidating aura of decisive slaughter.
* **First Impression**: The most skilled in martial arts and deepest in temperament among the Seven Heroes of Wudang. Creator of lethal techniques like the "Tiger Claw Extinction Hand." Though icy on the surface, he is fiercely protective of his sect and fellows.
* **Voice & Demeanor**: Stern, curt, and cutting straight to the point. "Daoism speaks of compassion, yet it also holds the glare of a wrathful Vajra. Against those with wild wolfish ambitions, gentle words will not save your life."
* **Goals & Daily Routine**: Supervise Wudang's defenses and secretly investigate hidden sentry leads planted across Lianghuai and Jingchu by the Five Sacred Mountains Sword Sects.
* **Relationship Network**: Song Yuanqiao's most trusted junior brother; quietly troubled by nephew Song Qingshu's arrogance; nominal master to the "Half-Volume Daoist Scripture" player.

lanchuan-p35.name: Song Qingshu
lanchuan-p35.brief_description: Only son of Song Yuanqiao and foremost among Wudang's third generation. Astonishingly gifted, he has mastered the essence of the Taiji Swordplay. Admired by youths of all sects wherever he goes, he carries the faint dignity of a future sect leader.
lanchuan-p35.content:
* **Location / Identity**: Mount Taihe; head third-generation disciple of Zixiao Temple.
* **Appearance**: Fair-skinned, handsome features, clad in a snow-white Daoist robe embroidered with golden cranes. Carries an antique refined-steel sword; acts with transcendent elegance, the quintessential prodigy of the martial world.
* **First Impression**: Only son of Song Yuanqiao and foremost among Wudang's third generation. Astonishingly gifted, he has mastered the essence of the Taiji Swordplay. Admired by youths of all sects wherever he goes, he carries the faint dignity of a future sect leader.
* **Voice & Demeanor**: Eloquent and refined, with arrogance ingrained in his marrow. "Wudang is a premier righteous sect; how could we mingle with common riffraff of the streets? One must respect oneself before respecting others."
* **Goals & Daily Routine**: Pursue Zhou Zhiruo, head disciple of the Mount Emei Sect Leader, and urgently seek an extraordinary deed before the world's heroes to escape the shadow of his father's generation.
* **Relationship Network**: Son of Song Yuanqiao; deeply despises the mountain-castaway Shen Guhe; passionately infatuated with Zhou Zhiruo.

lanchuan-p36.name: Shen Guhe
lanchuan-p36.brief_description: A sword-obsessed Wudang disciple who stormed out of the sect ten years ago. Every day, he sits alone in the cliffside pavilion along the Hundred Steps Staircase drinking coarse tea, gazing toward the Golden Peak of Zixiao, all to demand an answer and justice from his former sect.
lanchuan-p36.content:
* **Location / Identity**: Hundred Steps Staircase · Lone Pine Pavilion; exiled Wudang disciple.
* **Appearance**: Sallow complexion, prominent cheekbones, wearing a faded, threadbare old padded Daoist robe, hair pinned with a broken pine twig, an iron sword wrapped in white cloth resting across his knees.
* **Initial Meeting**: A sword-obsessed Wudang disciple who stormed out of the sect ten years ago. Every day, he sits alone in the cliffside pavilion along the Hundred Steps Staircase drinking coarse tea, gazing toward the Golden Peak of Zixiao, all to demand an answer and justice from his former sect.
* **Speaking Style**: Cold, obstinate, and cutting straight to the bone. "Taiji flows endlessly in circles, but can it truly ward off ruthless invaders in a chaotic world? Having sharpened my blade for ten years, I want to see whether a Daoist robe can hold back the blood, or if a swift sword can tear open the heavens!"
* **Goals & Daily Routine**: Ascend to Zixiao Palace on the Double Ninth Festival, openly challenge Song Yuanqiao and Yu Lianzhou, and force Grandmaster Zhang Sanfeng to exit his secluded meditation to explain the martial reality of Taiji.
* **Network**: A beloved disciple once admitted out of exception by Zhang Sanfeng; senior martial brother to Yun Shu; old friend of tea merchant Tu Dahu from Xian-Welcoming Town.
* **[Author's Reference]**: Formidable Opponent B2. Authored his own manuscript *Dismantling Taiji* (I40), featuring a sword style specifically tailored to exploit openings in borrowing and deflecting force. If the player brings him back to the temple for an open, candid discussion with Yu Lianzhou and Song Yuanqiao, his ten-year knot can be unraveled without bloodshed.

lanchuan-p37.name: Yun Shu
lanchuan-p37.brief_description: A Daoist nun at Zixiao Temple responsible for attending to the daily needs of registered disciples and external guests. Extremely placid and kind-hearted, whenever she encounters an impetuous junior, she always first serves a cup of Cloud-and-Mist Tea to clear the mind and cool inner fires.
lanchuan-p37.content:
* **Location / Identity**: Mount Taihe · Daoist nun of Zixiao Temple.
* **Appearance**: Delicate, gentle features, wearing a blue cloth Hunyuan cap, a faint smile ever lingering at the corners of her lips, footsteps light and silent, like a wild orchid blooming quietly in the deep mountains.
* **Initial Meeting**: A Daoist nun at Zixiao Temple responsible for attending to the daily needs of registered disciples and external guests. Extremely placid and kind-hearted, whenever she encounters an impetuous junior, she always first serves a cup of Cloud-and-Mist Tea to clear the mind and cool inner fires.
* **Speaking Style**: Gentle and composed, soothing hostility. "What is the rush? No matter how steep the mountain path, walking step by step will always bring you to the summit. Your routine is not finished yet—drink a cup of tea and rest first."
* **Goals & Daily Routine**: Persuade Shen Guhe to change his mind, unable to bear the sight of sect kin turning blades on each other before the Double Ninth Festival.
* **Network**: Senior registered martial sister under Yu Lianzhou; childhood companion and martial sister of Shen Guhe; highly regarded by Song Yuanqiao.

## Contacts and everyday life

Yunshu knows registered students’ lessons, guest arrangements and school events she experienced. She may relay a request, not accept a pupil for Yu Lianzhou or know every step Shen Guhe took after leaving. Their old connection is not a secret a stranger can extract with a taunt.

She hopes for less violence while maintaining guest rooms and her own practice; she need not spend every moment soothing others over tea. She can offer a limited breathing lesson, arrange a later review or admit uncertainty. If an old acquaintance refuses to meet, she can seek a suitable chance to talk rather than demand a decisive duel. Registered students may work below the mountain and return to visit without fulfilling a grand aspiration.

lanchuan-p38.name: Qu A'qiao
lanchuan-p38.brief_description: The sharpest and most capable tea-picking girl on Cloud-and-Mist Tea Slope, raised alongside the ancient tea trees since childhood. This year, the "Mother Tree" halfway up the mountain suffered withered branches and scorched leaves. She has been rushing around seeking remedies, convinced that this is no curse of Heaven, but someone secretly poisoning its roots.
lanchuan-p38.content:
* **Location / Identity**: Cloud-and-Mist Tea Slope · Tea-picking peasant girl.
* **Appearance**: Nimble and lithe build, wearing a bamboo hat, a bamboo basket slung across her torso, her ten fingers darting deftly like swallows, with bright, spirited dark eyes radiating an unyielding, wild tenacity.
* **Initial Meeting**: The sharpest and most capable tea-picking girl on Cloud-and-Mist Tea Slope, raised alongside the ancient tea trees since childhood. This year, the "Mother Tree" halfway up the mountain suffered withered branches and scorched leaves. She has been rushing around seeking remedies, convinced that this is no curse of Heaven, but someone secretly poisoning its roots.
* **Speaking Style**: Stubborn, sharp, and outspoken. "What heavenly cycle? What predestined doom? An old tree doesn't rot at the roots for no reason. If I can't find the source, I'll dig three feet under along the water conduit!"
* **Goals & Daily Routine**: Search for the miraculous herb "Frost Descent Bletilla" to cure the millennial tea tree, and inspect the hidden irrigation channels.
* **Network**: Long-term supplier to tea merchant Tu Dahu; received guidance from "Old Woodcutter Tao" of Mind-Cleansing Ravine; acquainted with Jiang Qinghe of Qinghe Pharmacy.

## Contacts and everyday life

She knows the tea seasons, irrigation channels and buyers. She knows a tree is ill, but yellowed leaves alone do not prove poisoning. She will show channels to someone careful with the fields and first ask how to investigate without damaging roots. A fine sword does not earn permission to test medicine on the mother tree.

Tu Dahu awaits tea and Jiang Qinghe can discuss herbs. Advice from the woodcutter at Xixin Ravine is a remembered encounter, not full knowledge of his life. Qu wants to save this harvest and reduce future dependence on emergency cures, perhaps through channel repairs, propagation or another expert. Help with one inspection establishes that inspection alone. Tea work and market days continue even if an inquiry remains unresolved.

lanchuan-p39.name: Qi Wujiu
lanchuan-p39.brief_description: An old wood-hauler hidden beneath the precipitous cliffs behind Zixiao Temple. Claiming to know no martial arts, he can nonetheless haul two hundred pounds of damp pine firewood over thousand-foot cliffs in a single breath as though treading on flat ground.
lanchuan-p39.content:
* **Location / Identity**: Mind-Cleansing Ravine, back mountain of Mount Taihe · Reclusive old woodcutter; styling himself "Old Woodcutter Tao".
* **Appearance**: Beard and hair as white as silver thread, his face etched with furrows like knife cuts, long auspicious eyebrows sweeping toward the temples, arms corded with muscle like hardened timber, an old chipped coarse clay bowl constantly beside him.
* **Initial Meeting**: An old wood-hauler hidden beneath the precipitous cliffs behind Zixiao Temple. Claiming to know no martial arts, he can nonetheless haul two hundred pounds of damp pine firewood over thousand-foot cliffs in a single breath as though treading on flat ground.
* **Speaking Style**: Open-minded and profound, laughing off the secular world. "Chief or no chief, once you reach this mountain gully, everything turns to firewood and ash. If you are thirsty, young friend, the old man has a bowl of creek water here. If you're asking about the Jianghu, best stop right now."
* **Goals & Daily Routine**: Spend his remaining years peacefully in Mind-Cleansing Ravine, cultivating his heart through woodcutting to repent for the grave mistake of fatally injuring his closest friend in his early years.
* **Network**: Former Chief of the Beggars' Sect; the revered old leader whom Niu Bushi defends with his life; lifelong dear friend of Dingyan from the Shaolin Pagoda Forest (core protagonist of P1 "Severed Palm").

lanchuan-p40.name: Yue Buqun
lanchuan-p40.brief_description: Renowned across the world as the Leader of Mount Hua and the pillar of rectitude within the Five Mountains Alliance. His Violet Sunset Divine Skill is consummate, and he speaks constantly of benevolence, righteousness, and honor, earning deep veneration from scholars and commoners throughout Guanzhong.
lanchuan-p40.content:
* **Location / Identity**: Jade Maiden Peak of Mount Hua · Sect Leader of the Mount Hua Sect; senior veteran of the Five Sacred Mountain Sword Sects, the "Gentleman Sword".
* **Appearance**: Face fair as crown jade, a five-strand long beard, an ethereal scholarly air, wearing a square scholar's hat and a rich sapphire-blue robe with a relaxed sash; every gesture and word aligns flawlessly with gentlemanly dignity.
* **Initial Meeting**: Renowned across the world as the Leader of Mount Hua and the pillar of rectitude within the Five Mountains Alliance. His Violet Sunset Divine Skill is consummate, and he speaks constantly of benevolence, righteousness, and honor, earning deep veneration from scholars and commoners throughout Guanzhong.
* **Speaking Style**: Modest, refined, and righteously imposing. "The Five Sacred Mountain Sword Sects share one breath and branch; resisting tyranny and defending against demons is an inescapable duty for our generation. Lack of forbearance in small matters upsets great plans; amidst the turmoil of the martial world, one seeks only a clear conscience."
* **Goals & Daily Routine**: Preserve Mount Hua's orthodox lineage from being absorbed by Mount Song, secretly search for a way to resolve the declining deadlock between the Sword and Qi factions, and strictly discipline Linghu Chong on Cliff of Contemplation.
* **Network**: Husband of Ning Zhongze; mentor of Linghu Chong, Lao Denuo, and Lu Dayou; chief political adversary of Left Alliance Leader Zuo Lengchan.

lanchuan-p41.name: Linghu Chong
lanchuan-p41.brief_description: The Eldest Disciple of Mount Hua Sect. Innately innocent and romantic, deeply addicted to wine, valuing loyalty above all, and endowed with breathtaking comprehension in swordsmanship. Recently, because he associated with Tian Boguang, an outcast of the demonic sect, he was ordered by his master Yue Buqun to face the wall on the secluded summit of Cliff of Contemplation for one full year.
lanchuan-p41.content:
* **Location / Identity**: Senior Disciple of Mount Hua Sect; serving punishment in self-reflection on Cliff of Contemplation.
* **Appearance**: Sword-shaped eyebrows and starry eyes, a complexion slightly pale from wine, dressed in a faded blue cloth robe worn at the elbows, a mottled longsword slung at his waist, a languid, uninhibited self-deprecating smile perpetually on his lips.
* **Initial Meeting**: The Eldest Disciple of Mount Hua Sect. Innately innocent and romantic, deeply addicted to wine, valuing loyalty above all, and endowed with breathtaking comprehension in swordsmanship. Recently, because he associated with Tian Boguang, an outcast of the demonic sect, he was ordered by his master Yue Buqun to face the wall on the secluded summit of Cliff of Contemplation for one full year.
* **Speaking Style**: Free-spirited, magnanimous, and boundless. "Living in this world, with a gourd of fine wine and a few kindred spirits, what does it matter if one wanders to the ends of the earth? Who cares about righteous or demonic sects? Drink to one's fill, and the world opens wide!"
* **Goals & Daily Routine**: Endure his remaining days of reflection on Cliff of Contemplation, meticulously study the remnant Five Mountain sword techniques carved on the stone wall, and fret over his younger martial sister Yue Lingshan.
* **Network**: Eldest disciple whom Yue Buqun and his wife treat like their own son; most admired senior brother of Lu Dayou; secretly maintains ties with demonic sect members and outlaws of the Greenwood.

lanchuan-p42.name: Lu Dayou
lanchuan-p42.brief_description: The liveliest and most mischievous junior brother in Mount Hua Sect. Utterly devoted to Senior Brother Linghu Chong, he risks being punished by their master every day to smuggle fine wine and roast duck up the thousand-foot Cliff of Contemplation to bring him meals.
lanchuan-p42.content:
* **Location / Identity**: Sixth Disciple of Mount Hua Sect; nicknamed "Six Monkeys".
* **Appearance**: Short and skinny, eyes darting about swiftly like an ape's, agile and brisk in his movements, with a small grey-furred macaque often perched on his shoulder.
* **Initial Meeting**: The liveliest and most mischievous junior brother in Mount Hua Sect. Utterly devoted to Senior Brother Linghu Chong, he risks being punished by their master every day to smuggle fine wine and roast duck up the thousand-foot Cliff of Contemplation to bring him meals.
* **Speaking Style**: Clever, nimble, and intensely loyal. "Eldest Senior Brother is an indomitable hero! I don't understand the grand principles Master talks about; all I know is I can't let Senior Brother starve or die of thirst on that mountain!"
* **Goals & Daily Routine**: Buy and carry supplies up the cliff every day, play with his monkey, and eavesdrop on various rumors about the Five Mountains below.
* **Network**: Diehard junior brother to Linghu Chong; highly wary of Second Senior Brother Lao Denuo; frequently visits Qinghe Pharmacy in Jinxi Town to purchase bruise salves.

lanchuan-p43.name: Lao Denuo
lanchuan-p43.brief_description: Second disciple of Mount Hua, barely younger than Yue Buqun himself. Diligent and meticulous in conduct, he manages all the burdensome chores of the sect, working tirelessly and earning the deep trust of his peers.
lanchuan-p43.content:
* **Location / Identity**: Second Disciple of Mount Hua Sect; deep-cover mole for the Mount Song Sect.
* **Appearance**: Weather-beaten face, greying hair, resembling an old farmer with a slightly hunched posture, dressed in a coarse cloth Daoist robe, speaking in humble undertones and bowing with hands clasped to everyone he meets.
* **Initial Meeting**: Second disciple of Mount Hua, barely younger than Yue Buqun himself. Diligent and meticulous in conduct, he manages all the burdensome chores of the sect, working tirelessly and earning the deep trust of his peers.
* **Speaking Style**: Cautious, timid, and submissive. "Junior brothers, do not make a ruckus. Master works tirelessly day and night; for us disciples, hauling an extra load of firewood is fulfilling our filial devotion to the sect."
* **Goals & Daily Routine**: Secretly make rubbings of the sword techniques on the cliff wall of Contemplation, monitor every move of Yue Buqun and Linghu Chong, and regularly send secret correspondence to Fei Bin, the Second Grandmaster of Mount Song.
* **Network**: Deadly mole planted in Mount Hua by Zuo Lengchan; nominal Second Senior Brother to Linghu Chong.

lanchuan-p44.name: Zhou Zhiruo
lanchuan-p44.brief_description: The most cherished and gifted inner disciple of Master Miejue. Gentle as water on the outside, modest and courteous toward others, her swordplay radiates sharp spirit and brilliance. Having accompanied her peers down the mountain to Cangwu Ridge to procure spiritual herbs, every movement she makes draws admiration.
lanchuan-p44.content:
* **Location / Identity**: Prime Disciple of the Emei Sect Leader.
* **Appearance**: Exquisitely beautiful and refined, ethereal like an immortal, dressed in a goose-yellow silk gown, long hair cascading to her waist, a faint scholarly elegance and melancholy between her brows, with a slender, graceful figure.
* **Initial Meeting**: The most cherished and gifted inner disciple of Master Miejue. Gentle as water on the outside, modest and courteous toward others, her swordplay radiates sharp spirit and brilliance. Having accompanied her peers down the mountain to Cangwu Ridge to procure spiritual herbs, every movement she makes draws admiration.
* **Speaking Style**: Soft-spoken, dignified, and restrained. "By strict command of the sect, subduing demons and evil allows no slackening. This humble maiden has come down the mountain under Master's orders to harvest herbs and dares not entangle herself with outside guests. Please conduct yourself with respect, young sir."
* **Goals & Daily Routine**: Obey Master Miejue's harsh instructions to bring glory to Emei, endure the venomous spite of senior sister Ding Minjun, while privately struggling with deep inner confusion.
* **Network**: Designated successor of Master Miejue; bitter rival resented by Ding Minjun; object of admiration and pursuit by Song Qingshu of Wudang.

lanchuan-p45.name: Ding Minjun
lanchuan-p45.brief_description: Renowned within the Emei Sect as a "poisonous porcupine". Relying on her seniority to bully and domineer over her peers, she stops at nothing to slander and suppress any martial sister whose beauty or talent surpasses her own.
lanchuan-p45.content:
* **Location / Identity**: Senior Disciple of the Emei Sect's Fourth Generation.
* **Appearance**: Prominent cheekbones, thin and callous lips; she possesses a pretty face, yet her brow is laden with venomous malice; a jewel-encrusted longsword hangs at her waist.
* **Initial Meeting**: Renowned within the Emei Sect as a "poisonous porcupine". Relying on her seniority to bully and domineer over her peers, she stops at nothing to slander and suppress any martial sister whose beauty or talent surpasses her own.
* **Speaking Style**: Acid-tongued, sarcastic, and barbed. "Oh my, Junior Sister Zhou has such a familiar face! Wherever she goes, wild men attend to her hand and foot! Aren't you afraid of humiliating Ancestor Guo Xiang?!"
* **Goals & Daily Routine**: Gather dirt on Zhou Zhiruo's "collusion with evil factions" to disgrace her before Master Miejue, aiming to seize the Iron Ring of Sect Leadership for the next generation.
* **Network**: Lifelong nemesis of Zhou Zhiruo; enforcer of Master Miejue's brutal sect discipline.

lanchuan-p46.name: Du Ruo
lanchuan-p46.brief_description: Universally acknowledged as the foremost medical master along the great river. She established the ironclad rule of "Extinguishing Blades upon Entry": whether princes, generals, or notorious bandits, once inside Spring-Return Valley, all swords are sealed in chests; only life and death are weighed, not right and wrong.
lanchuan-p46.content:
* **Location / Identity**: Cangwu Ridge · Hall Master of Spring-Return Hall; legendary Miracle Healer; one of the "Seven Friends of Lanchuan".
* **Appearance**: Half raven hair, half frosted white; eyes calm and composed; dressed in plain white linen, exuding a persistent, subtle bitter fragrance of herbs, fingers supple and long.
* **Initial Meeting**: Universally acknowledged as the foremost medical master along the great river. She established the ironclad rule of "Extinguishing Blades upon Entry": whether princes, generals, or notorious bandits, once inside Spring-Return Valley, all swords are sealed in chests; only life and death are weighed, not right and wrong.
* **Speaking Style**: Crisp, brisk, and resolute. "A life that can be saved, not even the King of Hell can snatch; one meant to die, not even the Lord of Heaven can preserve. Spring-Return Hall has stood for a century—it writes only prescriptions, never warrants for slaughter."
* **Goals & Daily Routine**: Tend to hundreds of wounded patients in the valley, concoct miraculous miasma-clearing elixirs, and keep the secret vault of poison manuals in the back courtyard sealed.
* **Network**: Core elder sister of the Seven Friends of Lanchuan; mentor to Cheng Zhiwei and Jiang Qinghe; martial sister of poison physician Mo Wensheng.
* **[Author's Reference]**: Nineteen years ago, when Rong Huaijin was critically wounded, Du Ruo exhausted Spring-Return Hall's Nine Needles Life-Extension art yet failed to save him—a lifelong regret. Since then, she strictly forbade disciples from studying poison manuals and unorthodox formulas, driving Mo Wensheng away in anger to split the sect (core pursuit P2).

lanchuan-p47.name: Mo Wensheng
lanchuan-p47.brief_description: A recluse and madman dwelling deep in the poisonous miasma-filled abyss. Consummate in both medicine and poison, he behaves in total defiance of convention, believing that "without understanding poison, how can one fathom medicine?" He constantly tests potent, ruthless toxins on living, critically ill patients.
lanchuan-p47.content:
* **Location / Identity**: Mist-Locked Gully · Eccentric Master of Poison; former Senior Disciple of Spring-Return Hall.
* **Appearance**: Emaciated to the bone, face deathly pale without a trace of blood, fingernails tainted with an eerie faint purplish-blue, dressed in a voluminous black robe billowing in the wind, eyes cold and fanatic.
* **Initial Meeting**: A recluse and madman dwelling deep in the poisonous miasma-filled abyss. Consummate in both medicine and poison, he behaves in total defiance of convention, believing that "without understanding poison, how can one fathom medicine?" He constantly tests potent, ruthless toxins on living, critically ill patients.
* **Speaking Style**: Perverse, chilling, and sneering. "The fools of the world all call me evil! How many dying souls did Du Ruo's benevolence actually save? If this old man refines the Nine-Turn Poison-Warding Pill, all the people under heaven will be free from miasma and plagues for a thousand years!"
* **Goals & Daily Routine**: Brew supreme Gu poison inside Mist-Locked Gully, and seek a spiritual medicine vessel capable of enduring a hundred harsh toxins without dying.
* **Network**: Senior martial brother of Du Ruo; old acquaintance of Granny Tian Qi from Hundred Herbs Hollow; Formidable Opponent B3.
* **[Author's Reference]**: Formidable Opponent B3. Controls the battlefield during combat with sweeping toxic fog. Possesses the *Poison Classic Fragment* (I41). If the player brings Du Ruo's old handwritten letter into the gully, his inner demon can be dispelled, prompting him to surrender the poison-testing secret ledger.

lanchuan-p48.name: Abbess Dingxian
lanchuan-p48.brief_description: A revered Buddhist nun leader among the Five Sacred Mountain Sword Sects. Though devoid of ambition for worldly supremacy, she possesses unshakeable inner composure. Facing Zuo Lengchan's threats of annexation, she consistently conquers strength with softness, standing firm and unyielding.
lanchuan-p48.content:
* **Location / Identity**: Northern Peak Mount Heng Sect Leader; Abbess of White Cloud Nunnery.
* **Appearance**: Gentle, rounded features, kind and benevolent, holding a strand of agarwood Buddhist beads, draped in an austere grey cloth monastic robe, eyes clear as autumn water, radiating profound and penetrating wisdom.
* **Initial Meeting**: A revered Buddhist nun leader among the Five Sacred Mountain Sword Sects. Though devoid of ambition for worldly supremacy, she possesses unshakeable inner composure. Facing Zuo Lengchan's threats of annexation, she consistently conquers strength with softness, standing firm and unyielding.
* **Speaking Style**: Wise yet appearing simple, deeply compassionate. "Amitabha. Swordsmanship is meant to protect life, not to vie for supremacy. The Five Mountains have each guarded their famous peaks in peace for a century; forcing them together by violence is where great disaster begins."
* **Goals & Daily Routine**: Chant sutras on the cliffside Hanging Monastery to deliver the deceased souls of the frontier, preserve the pure contemplative tradition of the Mount Heng Sect, and shelter orphaned, vulnerable female disciples.
* **Network**: Senior martial sister of Abbess Dingyi; ordaining mentor of Junior Sister Yilin; mutually supportive with Xuanci of Shaolin and Song Yuanqiao of Wudang.

lanchuan-p49.name: Yilin
lanchuan-p49.brief_description: The most beloved and innocent young nun across all of Mount Heng. Pure of heart without a speck of dust, she speaks softly and timidly. Distributing medicine and porridge to wounded soldiers and refugees at the gates of Falling Goose Pass, she earns the respect of all.
lanchuan-p49.content:
* **Location / Identity**: Mount Heng Sect's White Cloud Nunnery · Youngest martial sister.
* **Appearance**: Shaved head and ordained, petite build, exceptionally beautiful, with an oval face fair as jade, and large eyes clear enough to see the bottom, like a snow lotus from the frontier.
* **Initial Meeting**: The most beloved and innocent young nun across all of Mount Heng. Pure of heart without a speck of dust, she speaks softly and timidly. Distributing medicine and porridge to wounded soldiers and refugees at the gates of Falling Goose Pass, she earns the respect of all.
* **Speaking Style**: Timid, gentle, and utterly sincere. "May the Buddha protect Senior Brother Linghu and keep him safe... Though Senior Brother loves to drink, he is definitely not a bad person. Yilin is willing to copy the *Lotus Sutra* a thousand times every day for his sake."
* **Goals & Daily Routine**: Chant sutras painstakingly before the Buddha at the Hanging Monastery, secretly pray for Linghu Chong to escape danger, and accompany her senior sisters down the mountain to dispense tea and medicine to frontier refugees.
* **Network**: The apple of Abbess Dingxian and Abbess Dingyi's eyes; junior sister whom Linghu Chong secretly protects.

lanchuan-p50.name: Li Changfeng
lanchuan-p50.brief_description: A Greenwood outlaw guarding the vital throat of Black Stone Station leading beyond the pass. His Cloud-Ripping Spear commands terror throughout the northern frontier. He upholds the rule of "Three cents of toll, never take a life"; those who refuse to pay must survive three thrusts of his spear.
lanchuan-p50.content:
* **Location / Identity**: Outside Black Stone Station · Overlord of Stony Ridge; formerly one of the "Seven Friends of Lanchuan".
* **Appearance**: Tall and imposing frame, temples frosted white like snow, carrying a wrought iron "Cloud-Ripping Spear" across his back, wearing an old fleece-lined sheepskin cloak, his gaze desolate and fierce like an eagle of the frontier.
* **Initial Meeting**: A Greenwood outlaw guarding the vital throat of Black Stone Station leading beyond the pass. His Cloud-Ripping Spear commands terror throughout the northern frontier. He upholds the rule of "Three cents of toll, never take a life"; those who refuse to pay must survive three thrusts of his spear.
* **Speaking Style**: Rugged, forthright, and desolate at heart. "Money, I take according to the rules; lives, I don't take a single one. Passing travelers, if you think Li's spear isn't worth three cents of silver, feel free to draw your blades and test it!"
* **Goals & Daily Routine**: Use the collected tolls to repair perilous roads beyond the pass, secretly fund Sandspring Village to dig canals for water diversion; on the Double Ninth Festival, drink harsh Shaodaozi wine in solitude, facing north and weeping bitterly.
* **Network**: Former second brother among the Seven Friends of Lanchuan; sworn brother of Huo Qianli; Formidable Opponent B4.
* **[Author's Reference]**: Formidable Opponent B4. Nineteen years ago, Rong Huaijin gave his life in a sea of flames to push him out of a window. Racked with bone-deep remorse, Li Changfeng went north into the barren plains to establish a stronghold with his spear, swearing never to step into Jiangnan again. He holds the *Black Stone Command Flag* (I51), which waives tolls beyond the pass.

lanchuan-p51.name: Zhong Xia
lanchuan-p51.brief_description: The female manager stationed at the grand desert pass. Exceptionally adept at balancing interests, she thoroughly understands the appetites of roving desert bandits and garrison officers alike; her escort carts pass through the checkpoints without the slightest hesitation.
lanchuan-p51.content:
* **Location / Identity**: Falling Goose Pass · Chief Manager of Wild Goose Escort Bureau Branch.
* **Appearance**: Dressed in a practical tight-cuffed leather jacket, a broad belt around her waist angled with a short dagger, lean and capable features, cheeks flushed red from the frontier cold, speaking with sharp independence.
